payload.summary: schema.sql declares pg_cron without a schema, unlike every other extension line
payload.detail: supabase/schema.sql:15 is 'create extension if not exists "pg_cron";' while lines 12-14 (vector, pg_trgm, uuid-ossp) all say 'with schema extensions'. Raised by copilot on PR #2697. It is inert in every environment this repo touches: the drift manifest generated by the Migration replay job on supabase/postgres:17.6.1.127 records {"name":"pg_cron","schema":"pg_catalog"}, so the extension already exists there and on the live project, and 'if not exists' short-circuits before any schema is chosen. On a genuinely fresh database the schema would be decided by search_path (currently public, extensions) instead, which is the drift the reviewer is pointing at. Not fixed in #2697 because editing schema.sql invalidates supabase/drift-manifest.json, regenerating it needs Docker, and no agent environment here has Docker - so the change could only be pushed red to harvest a fresh manifest from CI. Do it as its own change, where the replay job can prove 'with schema pg_catalog' is accepted.
